# City Guide NY

> > City Guide NY is a hospitality concierge platform operated by Davler Media Group, providing restaurant booking, attraction directories, and guest services for New York venues and hotels.

The platform serves as a comprehensive concierge connection tool for hospitality professionals, featuring venue search capabilities, guest ticket services, and ColdFusion-based backend services for managing New York City attractions and dining experiences.

## Key Topics

- Concierge Connections
- Davler Media Group
- New York hospitality services
- Restaurant booking
- Attraction directory
- Guest Ticket Express
- Venue search
- Hospitality concierge tools
- ColdFusion services
- Hotel guest connections
- Broadway attractions
- Hornblower cruises
- LatCom Systems
- 1501 Broadway
